name: smwsprites-yi-wild-ptooie-piranha-plant-v3
title: YI Wild Ptooie & Piranha Plant v3.1
description:
YI Wild Piranha Plant v3.0:
This is my second time re-coding this sprite. It now uses "gradual" rotation when hit instead of directly setting the value. It shares GFX with the Ptooie.

YI Wild Ptooie v3.0:
This is my first time coding the Wild Ptooie, but there were already two versions made by smkdan. The main features in this one are: "gradual" rotation, scaling head when tracking, and facing-down frames.

Includes a document on how to customize the Wild Ptooie

v3.1 (spooonsss): convert to asar and pixi. Support for SA-1.
